risks.description: High error rate in existing manual data makes establishing a reliable baseline difficult.
Strict data residency requirements prohibit the use of public LLM endpoints.
Complexity of legal phrasing in amendments may lead to missed notice windows.

open_questions.question: What are the specific RESTful API endpoints and data mapping requirements for the SAP/Property Management database integration?
What is the expected monthly volume of new documents following the initial 15,000 historical files?

acceptance_criteria: System generates email or SAP-based alerts for upcoming notice windows at configurable intervals (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days).
inferred_requirements.requirement: Automated Alerting System for notice windows and renewals.
inferred_requirements.rationale: The proposal mentions an 'Automated Alerting System' in the deliverables and risks section to mitigate missed notice windows, though it isn't a standalone FR in the matrix.
The prose mentions that the HITL process is fully audited to capture manual overrides for model refinement and audits.
inferred_requirements.requirement: Audit trail for manual overrides in the HITL portal.
acceptance_criteria: Every manual correction in the HITL portal is logged with the user ID, timestamp, original value, and new value.

summary: A proposal for an Azure-native AI Contract Intelligence system designed for Apex Global Solutions to automate data extraction from commercial leases and supplier contracts. The system aims to achieve high accuracy within a private, secure cloud environment to reduce costs and mitigate financial risks from missed renewals.

requirements_needing_clarification.question: Which specific fields must be extracted to meet the 92% accuracy target?

assumptions.description: Apex Global Solutions will provide the necessary API credentials and network access for SharePoint and SAP integrations.
The 15,000 historical documents provided for initial training/testing are representative of future lease and contract variations.
Azure consumption costs are managed and paid for directly by Apex Global Solutions under their existing enterprise agreement.
Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) will be available for at least 4 hours per week during the Discovery and UAT phases.

acceptance_criteria: Reduce operational costs by 50% compared to current manual processes.

requirements_register.description: Eliminate financial risks from missed notice windows and unintended auto-renewals.
acceptance_criteria: Eliminate financial losses ($350,000/year) stemming from missed notice windows and unintended auto-renewals.

requirements_register.description: Extract data from complex multi-page PDF documents (scanned and native).
acceptance_criteria: Successfully extract structured data from complex multi-page PDF documents, both scanned and native.
OCR must handle legal document fonts and table structures in scanned PDF images.
requirements_register.description: OCR processing for scanned PDF images (~60% of dataset).

acceptance_criteria: Portal allows side-by-side review and manual correction for extractions with confidence < 88%.
requirements_register.description: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) interface for verification of extractions below 88% confidence.

acceptance_criteria: Real-time ingestion of documents uploaded to specified SharePoint locations via Azure Logic Apps.

requirements_register.description: Export structured data to SAP/Property Management database via RESTful APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Validated data is pushed to SAP via RESTful APIs with error logging and retry logic.

requirements_register.description: Support for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) vectorization.
acceptance_criteria: Implement Azure AI Search vector store to support semantic querying of contracts.
Measured accuracy of extracted fields must be at least 92% after HITL verification.
Total time from ingestion to SAP export is less than 180 seconds per document.
More than 80% of the target user group uses the system within 60 days of launch.
requirements_register.description: User Adoption > 80% team usage in 60 days.

acceptance_criteria: No data leaves the Apex-managed Azure tenant or US-East/East-US-2 regions. No external API calls.
requirements_register.description: All model training, RAG vectorization, and execution must occur strictly within Apex's private Microsoft Azure tenant (US-East / East-US-2 regions).
Security & Compliance: SOC 2 Type II certified vendor processes, HIPAA/GDPR alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Vendor must provide proof of SOC 2 Type II certification and compliance with GDPR/HIPAA.
Storage uses AES-256 and network traffic uses TLS 1.3.
requirements_register.description: Full encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).

acceptance_criteria: Total implementation fee is between $100,000 and $175,000.
Support available for 90 days after production launch.

coverage_gaps.description: The proposal does not specify data retention policies for documents stored in Azure Blob Storage or the lifecycle of processed data.
While Azure Monitor is mentioned, specific logging and alerting requirements for security incidents or compliance auditing are not detailed.

requirement_priorities.requirement_text: All model training, RAG vectorization, and execution must occur strictly within Apex's private Microsoft Azure tenant.
requirement_priorities.rationale: The document states this as a mandatory mandate prohibiting external API calls.
A primary success metric for the initiative.
Necessary to bridge the gap between AI confidence and the 92% accuracy target.
